dedupe_keys.name: 道の駅 roads bridges and tunnels

description: 道の駅 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大阪府. 大阪府域に設置されている「道の駅」について、名称、路線名、設置者、登録年月の他、紹介されているサイトを取りまとめたものです。. Coverage: 大阪府. The portal files it under the publisher 大阪府. Its tags are 道の駅, 道路. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2021-09-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
